doc.title: John Lamb interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 16, 2001

title: Shreveport: officers, spiritual meeting in the balcony
summary: On base in Shreveport there is no segregation among musicians and officers, but he sits in the balcony at a spiritual conference.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: I think ’58, ’59, ’58. But on the air base everything was fine. There were quite a few officers that played instruments that had love for the music. And because I had my little prestige thing going they all wanted to come over and play with me. So we had that kind of relationship. There was no segregation as far as officers and enlisted men. And every time one of these guys would walk into the barracks or they came to see me, guys would snap up, and they said oh, John, meet so-and-so and let’s make this gig. You know what I mean? And that was the end of that. And while were we in Shreveport, like I said, this guy used to come out once a week and talk to me. After that, during that period they had a general conference of all the spiritual people getting together in this big auditorium in town. And I was a part of the group. “John, we’d like to have you come but there’s nothing we can do to get around this law.” So they says, “we have a solution. You comply with the law, you sit up there in the balcony,” and there were about five or six other people out there in the main auditorium there, and of course I was used to balconies, you know the movie theatres and that type of thing. So I was used to balconies. And so I put on my uniform, full dress you know, because I wanted to have this experience just to see. So I went through that experience and here was the representative to the main office talking to this spiritual group. And so the meeting is over and he came over and shook my hand and that was the end of that. So later on in the band thing, the © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-
military part — this is unrelated to the meeting — they said, “John, we have an opening for you to ship out someplace if you want.” “Where is this?” “Newfoundland.”
